notes: General: Early-stage SMB, product-led inbound. Main goal: lightweight chat support bot integrated into existing docs portal and site chat widget.

Performance targets: median response latency < 400ms for single-turn chat; embedding-based doc search queries at 200 qps peak (burst to 800) for nightly digest jobs. Cost sensitivity: high — looking to keep hosted costs under $2k/mo in POC phase.

POC acceptance criteria (informal): successful end-to-end flow with chat widget using Vercel SDK, RAG with LlamaIndex returning relevant docs >70% in blind eval, stable latency under 500ms for 95th percentile on sample traffic.

Requested artifacts: 1) LangChain python quickstart (chain + convo memory + Redwood SDK example). 2) LlamaIndex index + query example using Redwood embeddings and hosted_api. 3) Next.js + Vercel AI SDK minimal drop-in sample with streaming responses.
